title: WaitlistBookingConfirmedV1
description: Outbox event (spec 11 §5.1) emitted when a waitlist offer is committed: either the customer accepted (finalizing the temporary hold against the offer's provisional operation) or it auto-booked under a recorded consent grant (§20). Drives the customer's booking-confirmed notification. The full verified booking submission remains the spec-04 path; this event records that capacity was finalized. Carries only opaque ids and the notification channel (Inv-12).

message_type.description: Explicit schema discriminator; always 'waitlist.booking_confirmed.v1' for this contract.

correlation_id.description: Correlation identifier propagated across the waitlist chain (the enrollment id).

offer_id.description: Stable id of the accepted/auto-booked waitlist_offers row.

enrollment_id.description: Stable id of the originating waitlist_enrollments row.

operation_id.description: Provisional booking operation id the finalized hold was committed against (spec 07).

customer_ref.description: Opaque tenant-scoped customer reference; never raw contact details (Inv-12).

notification_channel.description: Customer's chosen delivery channel for the confirmation notification.

slot_start_at.description: Start time of the confirmed slot.

auto_booked.description: True when the offer was committed automatically under a recorded consent grant (§20) rather than an explicit customer accept.
